name: gcc-mods
description: gcc's owner surfaces inside the Claude Code TUI: clickable paths, catchup band, context gauge, docs and tasks panes, fleet and wakes, hook router and nudge panel, decision pane, proof receipt, and a few situational touches.

startOn.title: Start on
startOn.description: Turn the mod on in every new session. Off: a session starts with the mod silent, and /hub turns it on for that session.

hygiene.title: Transcript hygiene
hygiene.description: Clickable absolute paths and compact seat and peer rows in the transcript.

continuity.title: Continuity
continuity.description: Catchup band after a clear or resume, context and usage gauge, core-dump button, Docs tab.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Tasks pane over the goal record, pending chips, stopped-with-open-work nudge.

tasksWrite.title: Tasks pane writes
tasksWrite.description: Let the Tasks pane record accepts and callouts through gs. Off makes the pane read-only.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Sub-agent seats in the band, landing toasts, seat wake when a report sits unread.

wake.title: Wake
wake.description: Show ipc mail and pending decisions; wake an idle session when a decision-page answer or an unread seat report lands.

mailWake.title: Mail wake
mailWake.description: Also wake an idle session for new ipc mail. Off by default: claude-ipc has its own delivery and this is only a layer over it.

router.title: Hook router
router.description: Route tagged owner text out of hook output and onto a surface instead of the model.

nudges.title: Nudge panel
nudges.description: What fired this session, why, snooze and feedback.

decide.title: Decision pane
decide.description: Pending decision pages drawn in the TUI, with submit.

receipt.title: Proof receipt
receipt.description: Beside a done-claim: last run, last screenshot, last curl this turn.

fun.title: Fun
fun.description: Situational spinner words, greeting, landing phrases, goal-met toast.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A short system sound on a seat landing (macOS afplay).
